title: Releases
grantsHelp: Open individual apps for this organization only. Everything not switched on here follows Admin → Flags.
visibilityHelp: Show or hide an app for this organization's members. Hiding only removes the app from their Store and rail; API and MCP work keeps running.
grantsPreviewHelp: Release preview is on, so this organization already sees every app. These switches take effect once preview is turned off.
